title: 前人未踏のチャレンジ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today we have a photo shoot for a magazine. They're running a special feature on Seeking the Pearl's signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: That's great, Pearl! Next up, I'd like to capture the design on the back. Can you turn around while keeping your face toward the camera?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm… That's not a bad idea, but I'm feeling something different.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do go on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Showing off my signature racewear through photographs is fine and all, but I've envisaged a little something I'd like to try!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Is that so? I'd be happy to try and bring your vision to life.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You see, I believe everything should be a challenge! I want to capture the yet untried and unknown! I want to shine in a way nobody's ever shined before!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I… see? Do you have a particular scenario in mind you want to try out?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, I want to do a treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: …Eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swept up by Seeking the Pearl's energy, we somehow find ourselves doing the shoot in the forest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm going to discover a brand new species of plant right here in this forest! Make sure you don't miss the shot!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure I won't! But, uh… why are we doing a treasure hunt again?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Discovering a new species is certainly an interesting challenge, but won't that be quite difficult to do?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure, it won't be a walk in the park—or the forest—but that's what makes it a challenge! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I was hoping this was a new species, but I guess I was wrong. I've seen this flower before.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Phew… We've been walking around and searching for hours, but we haven't found anything. I knew this wouldn't be easy…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha… Sure, but it's game over if you give up! The key is to never give up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's crucial to hold on to the belief that you'll absolutely achieve what you set out to do! Come on, let's check out that undergrowth over there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm… There doesn't seem to be anything around here. Let's head deeper! Onward we go!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wait, we're heading even deeper into the forest?! Is there really a need to keep going? We already have more than enough for the article…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Oh, I'm so sorry. You all must be tired. Why don't you take a break here? If I find anything, I'll come straight back!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: What?! Are you planning on continuing by yourself?! You must be exhausted as well, so why don't we call it a day and head ba—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Not a chance! I have to see my challenge through to the end. As long as I'm wearing my signature racewear, I can't give in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Your signature racewear? I-is there some kind of special meaning behind your costume's design? Please tell us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, well, it's proof of my potential! This outfit represents my vision of proving to the world what's possible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The eye-catching red base color symbolizes my passion for seeking out possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And the stars on the front of the outfit shine as guiding lights of hope. In other words, they're also symbols of my possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This challenge is my way of showing readers the meaning of my signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I give up the search now, we won't be able to take any convincing photos, and my feelings won't be conveyed. That's why I'm going to accomplish my goal, no matter how difficult it may be!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl… I apologize for failing to properly understand your vision!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: We'll follow you to the ends of the earth if that's what it takes for your challenge and determined spirit to be seen by the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha… Thank you! I'll find that undiscovered species without fail!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This plant… It's very rare, isn't it? There are so many of them growing in this area… Maybe, just maaaybe, there might be a new species hidden among them!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah! This… This one has differently shaped leaves! This must be an undiscovered flower!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Let me look it up right away! Gasp! I-I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl successfully discovered a new species of flower! By accomplishing such an extremely difficult task, she's realized part of the potential she preaches.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All that's left now is to take the final photo for the interview. What's the best way to tie my completion of this challenge to my vision in a way that's easy for readers to empathize with?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're right. That's my entire goal. I want the world to be a place where people can fearlessly take on challenges and never give up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …I've made up my mind! I'm going to go with a pose that directly touches the hearts of the readers!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Next, it's your turn to take on a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The photograph of Seeking the Pearl with the newly discovered species of flower later inspires courage in a great many people.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nice idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: To properly convey the image of a star, we'll need to collaborate with the night sky itself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the remainder of the shoot is scheduled for the evening.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stars are like lights of hope, emblems of possibility… And this flower proves those possibilities to be true.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If you seek out challenges, the whole world will open before you! Just follow my lead! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, when the magazine is published, the image of Seeking the Pearl shining beneath the starry sky gives her fans courage and sparks a huge buzz with the media.
